environmentVariables.name: COMFYUI_URL
environmentVariables.description: Required installation choice: your trusted running ComfyUI HTTP(S) endpoint. No credentials, query or fragment.

environmentVariables.name: WORKFLOWS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Required absolute existing directory containing your reviewed workflow API JSON and manifest pairs.

environmentVariables.name: DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Required absolute writable SQLite state directory. Use a separate directory per MCP process.

environmentVariables.name: AUTO_SAVE_OUTPUTS
environmentVariables.description: Application default: true. Download outputs on completion; false defers downloads to result queries.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_IN_FLIGHT
environmentVariables.description: Application default: 1. Integer 1-64; includes uncertain submissions.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_QUEUED_JOBS
environmentVariables.description: Application default: 1. Integer 1-64, no greater than MAX_IN_FLIGHT.
